data.name: Aws
data.gender_notes: Aws is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Given to those who are brave and fearless, like the roar of a lion. The name Aws carries the meaning “Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aws usually hope their child will grow to embody lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who has the strength of faith
data.etymology: Aws belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aws total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: أوس
in_arabic.meaning: يعني اسم أوس بالعربية القوة والشدة والقدرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أوس مشتق من الجذر العربي 'و س' الذي يعني القوة والشدة والقدرة. ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن قوة الله تعالى. يعتبر اسم أوس من الأسماء ذات المعنى القوي والشجاع في الثقافة الإسلامية العربية.

in_urdu.name: اوس
in_urdu.meaning: اوس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، شدت اور قابلیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اوس نام عربی جڑ 'و س' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت، شدت اور قابلیت۔ یہ نام قرآن کریم میں اللہ تعالی کی طاقت کے حوالے سے ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں اوس نام کو مضبوط اور بہادری کے معنی میں سمجھا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان۔

in_hindi.name: अوس
in_hindi.meaning: अوس का अर्थ है शक्ति, सख्ती और योग्यता
in_hindi.long_meaning: अوس नाम अरबी मूल 'و س' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति, सख्ती और योग्यता। यह नाम कुरआन में अल्लाह की शक्ति के संदर्भ में उल्लेखित है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अोस नाम को मजबूत और बहादुरी के अर्थ में माना जाता है।

in_pashto.name: اوس
in_pashto.meaning: د اوس نوم معنی دی ځواک، شديد او وړتیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: د اوس نوم د عربي ريښو 'و س' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د ځواک، شديد او وړتیا څخه عبارت دی. دا نوم د قرآن کریم په الله تعالی د قدرت په اړه ذکر شوی دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، اوس نوم د قوي او زړور په معنا کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Aws
in_english.meaning: Aws means strength, power, and capability in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aws is derived from the Arabic root 'و س', which means strength, power, and capability. Referenced in the Quran in the context of God's power, Aws signifies courage and resilience. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing strong personality traits.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aws is of Arabic origin, and in Islamic culture, it is believed that individuals with this name possess qualities of bravery, strength, and fearlessness. The Arabic language has a rich history, and the meaning of names holds significant importance. The name Aws evokes images of warriors and leaders, such as the famous companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) known as the Aws and Khazraj tribes. Their valor, courage, and loyalty to their leaders were renowned in early Islamic history. Therefore, a person named Aws is often viewed with pride and respect within the Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Aws lies in its powerful reminders to be courageous and steadfast in one's faith. In the Quran, individuals like Al-Aws and Al-Khazraj, known for their exemplary character, unwavering faith, and bravery, are mentioned as being among the chosen companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). This name serves as a constant reminder to emulate their traits and stay true to our spiritual path despite any challenges or adversity we may face. The beautiful name 'Aws pushes us to be warriors not only for ourselves but for our faith and community as well.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lion" symbolizes Given to those who are brave and fearless, like the roar of a lion.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aws serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lion.
